subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Sorts letters and words into alphabetical order

show.line: The alphabet has an order. Words in a dictionary follow it. Apple comes before banana, because 'a' comes before 'b'!

rounds.prompt: Which letter comes next in the alphabet?
Which word comes first in alphabetical order?
rounds.praise: Yes! Bee starts with 'b', which comes first.

rounds.prompt: Fish, goat, elephant. Which word comes last in alphabetical order?
Which letter comes right after 'p'? Say its name.
Which half of the alphabet? Put each letter card in its group.
Mango, apple, zebra. Which word comes first?
rounds.praise: Yes! Apple. 'a' is first in the alphabet.

hints: Sing the alphabet song. Stop at the letter you need.
Look at the first letter of each word. Which comes first in the alphabet?

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will put dog, cat and bird in order.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! 'b' comes first. Bird, cat, dog.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's sing it together. 'a', 'b', 'c', 'd'. Bird, cat, dog!

parent_line: Can put letters and words in alphabetical order.
